answer: Each epoch admits only 40 new identities through a sealed-bid burn auction: applicants lock a bid, the 40 highest pay their full bid burned, losers are refunded minus a 0.2 coin fee. A relic from an earlier cohort or a yarrow or karst label gives no priority. Creating 1,000 Sybils requires winning 25 full cohorts, burning 1,000 separate winning bids at a median 6 coins each, about 6,000 coins total, and waiting 25 epochs, with no bid reusable across identities.
